name: Bernardo Moreno
bio: a Senator from Ohio; born in Bogotá, Colombia, February 14, 1967; graduated Pinecrest Academy in Florida, 1985; B.A., business, University of Michigan, 1989; car dealership and technology company founder and chief executive officer; elected as a Republican to the United States Senate in 2024 for the term ending January 3, 2031.
